text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the traditional Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) arrives. In the waiting room, 
Biwa Hayahide leans in close to her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fussing over others was just Biwa 
Hayahide's nature. She couldn't help but 
check if the dark circles under the 
Trainer's eyes, brought on by lack of 
sleep, had faded at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reassured, Biwa Hayahide heads to the 
race. To prove the "Formula for Victory" 
built from the combined efforts of two.
